Noah (Content): Proposal: 2-week micro-launch: publish an OSS refapp repo + 3 short how-tos + a concise benchmark write-up. Aim: community demos + webinar signups. Quick yes/no?
Roxanne (DevRel): Yes. I'll scaffold the repo, add CONTRIBUTING, and include a tiny perf harness (docker + csv output).
Eli (Growth): I'll handle lead routing. Suggest Typeform (email only) -> Zapier -> HubSpot. utm_campaign=refapp_micro_q2. Will share mapping sheet.
June (Design): I can make hero + 3 tutorial thumbnails + a demo GIF. Need final copy by Wed EOD.
Kai (Ops): I'll create the Zapier catch hook in staging and run smoke tests. Will add a honeypot field on Typeform.
Noah (Content): Deliverables: refapp (Roxanne), 3 tutorials (Noah+Roxanne), benchmark post (Noah), landing & nurture (Eli), assets (June), zap + tests (Kai). Launch target: 14 days.
Eli (Growth): CTA A/B test: "Try the refapp" vs "Preview the demo" for 72 hours. Low-friction signup (email only).
HookBot: Zapier webhook test OK -> https://hooks.zapier.com/catch/24680/test (staging).
Noah (Content): Great — check-in in 3 days to surface blockers. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
